messages:
alex_sales: Hi team — fielding a POC for Glacier Health. They want to run a slim 13B variant (glacier-13b-slim) in prod-like conditions. Main asks: KMS integration for patient data, latency SLO <120ms p95, and pricing for Dedicated reserved capacity for 2 months. Can we confirm compatibility and blockers? :wave:
tori_eng: @alex_sales quick check: model uses custom tokenizer (sentencepiece) and a few extra special tokens. That's fine but we need to run a tokenizer warmup. KV cache layout is standard, no structural changes. Latency might be tight on 13B CPU — recommended quantized 8-bit on A10G or A40.
raju_infra: For Dedicated, capacity estimate: to meet 120ms p95 with 1k qps peak we'd need ~10x A10G equivalent nodes with batching tuned. For a 2-month POC at 200 qps we'd provision 2 nodes. Pricing ballpark? @alex_sales you can use reserve-rate + overage. I'll DM numbers.
alex_sales: Thanks. Client also sent a security questionnaire and requires BYOK/HSM KMS and SOC2 attestation. Any red flags?
mike_security: BYOK/HSM is supported in Private and Dedicated. Hosted requires limited key wrapping — we can support customer-managed keys in Dedicated via KMS proxy. We have SOC2 and can provide a short certificate pack. One ask: contract needs data residency for EU; ok to pin region.
tori_eng: A note on onboarding: we need the model artifact tar with tokenizer.json and a small sample eval set. We'll run a variant-compat scan; if quantization fails we may need a tiny model patch (layer norm/RMSnorm mismatch occasionally). ETA ~3 business days for scan + perf bench.
alex_sales: Great. Do we have a template for the onboarding checklist I can share with the customer? Also need a clear pricing quote for Dedicated commit vs Hosted fallback.
raju_infra: Checklist link: https://internal.redwood/onboard/checklists. Pricing: committed monthly node = $12k, short-term POC rate = 30% premium. I'll put numbers in a spreadsheet and tag you.
deploy-bot: Deployment request received: onboard_scan/glacier-13b-slim initiated by tori_eng — job 98432. Status: queued.
tori_eng: I'll start the scan once model artifacts arrive. If we hit RMSnorm issue I'll ping research for a quick patch.
alex_sales: Client follow-up: timeline ok with 3–5 business days. I'll ask for artifacts and KMS details. Thanks all :thumbsup:
